desc: Derive and prove the minimum-operation formula from the per-element division-by-4 depths, including handling an odd total number of required reductions.
Define the depth intervals for integers under repeated `floor(x / 4)` and derive a cumulative prefix-sum function `F(x)`.
Design an overflow-safe implementation for bounds up to `10^9` and up to `10^5` queries.
Write the Python solution using `F(r) - F(l - 1)` for each query and accumulate the rounded-up operation counts.
Validate the implementation on the provided examples and edge cases near powers of 4.
